coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-09-27, 2020-09-18, 2021-09-24, 2022-09-23, 2023-09-22, 2024-09-25, 2025-09-26, 2026-09-25), one table per fiscal year FY2019-FY2026: 93 rows (10, 12, 11, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12). The FY2019 and FY2023-FY2026 tables have Fees Earned or Paid in Cash, Stock Awards and Total columns; FY2020-FY2022 add All Other Compensation (non-zero only for Sikka in FY2020). Missing columns are recorded as 0, and every row's components sum to its printed total. Employee/executive directors (Ellison, Catz, Henley, Hurd in FY2019, Magouyrk and Sicilia from FY2026) get no board pay and are not in the tables (d117, d131, d175). Checked with no director table: the DEFA14A notices and supplements filed with each proxy (2019-2026, plus 2019-11-08 and 2021-10-27). No PRE 14A or 10-K/A was filed in the period. Searched the 2018-2021 proxies and FY2019-FY2022 10-Ks, plus EDGAR full-text search for 'director compensation' with 'settlement' (2017-2026). No lawsuit, settlement or clawback of director pay was found; the derivative suits disclosed concern the NetSuite acquisition, cloud disclosures and board composition. Fiscal years use Oracle's numbering (FY ends May 31; fiscal_year_ends from the 10-K covers, d211-d218).
